initial_npcs.name: King Aldric
initial_npcs.dialogue: The Wardens gave their names to hold the fire below, and I gave mine to hold this realm above. Different oaths, same weight. Walk safely, ember-touched — Greenrest remembers what it owes the old bloodline, even if you do not.

initial_npcs.name: Steward Yara
initial_npcs.dialogue: I have counted every wagon that never arrived, and I have stopped believing it is bandits. Bandits do not leave the ash undisturbed. Something is being carried out of the wastes, not stolen along a road.

initial_npcs.name: Corvin
initial_npcs.dialogue: Ember runes don't like to sit still in a pack — mind you keep them dry and away from open flame. Not that flame is much of a stranger to you, is it, Wanderer.

initial_npcs.name: Bard Fen
initial_npcs.dialogue: Every road remembers its travellers. The Ashen Barrow song has gained a new verse since you arrived.

initial_npcs.name: Guard Bren
initial_npcs.dialogue: The seals below weaken, and the wastes spill their creatures over the land. I pay good coin for every beast you put down — call it keeping the old watch.

initial_npcs.name: Farmer Jory
initial_npcs.dialogue: The vale fields feed the whole region. Mind the wolves up in the pines.

initial_npcs.name: Nessa
initial_npcs.dialogue: Captain Rowan's line has watched the north road since the Binding. We sleep easier for it — most nights.

initial_npcs.name: Maeve
initial_npcs.dialogue: The boars root near the eastern hedges. Orin pays attention to anyone carrying a bow.

initial_npcs.name: Scout Vale
initial_npcs.dialogue: I watch the Barrow door so the world need not. The ruins glow after sunset now — the seal is thinning, and I am the last set to watch it.

initial_npcs.name: Harker
initial_npcs.dialogue: Move along. I have got nothing for you.

initial_npcs.name: Brother Edric
initial_npcs.dialogue: Every traveller deserves a warm fire before crossing the snowfields.

initial_npcs.name: Fenwick
initial_npcs.dialogue: Dry boots cost extra in Sablemarsh. Everything else is fairly priced.

initial_npcs.name: Kessa
initial_npcs.dialogue: Mind your own fire, Wanderer, and I will mind mine.

initial_npcs.name: Pell
initial_npcs.dialogue: The old Warden stories used to be just stories. Now you are standing right here.
